questions.q: Whose is the Song of Songs, by its first line?
questions.evidence: The Song of songs, which is Solomon’s

questions.q: What is his banner over her, the Song says?
questions.evidence: His banner over me is love
I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys

questions.q: What spoils the vineyards in the Song?
questions.evidence: Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that plunder the vineyards

questions.q: "Behold, you are beautiful," the Song says. "Your eyes are" what?
questions.evidence: Your eyes are doves behind your veil
for love is strong as death
